notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). PlayStation 5 only (RAWG lists only PlayStation 5), so steam is None; the only Steam match by name was "ASTROBOTANICA", a different game. RAWG has no description text, tags or playtime for this game beyond a short credits line. StrategyWiki has a stub page under "Astro Bot" (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none exists, so nothing was used. astrobot.fandom.com is an unrelated robotics wiki, and playstation.fandom.com has only a generic "Astro Bot" page. The game is covered on astros-playroom.fandom.com under "Astro Bot (game)" (about 30 linked pages; its plain "Astro Bot" page is about the character). Chapters come from that wiki's page names only: its "Hub" page links Gorilla Nebula, Serpent Starway, Tentacle System, Feather Cluster and Camo Cosmos, and the galaxy pages link each other in the chain Gorilla Nebula, Tentacle System, Serpent Starway, Camo Cosmos, Feather Cluster, which was taken as the play order but not confirmed. Each boss is the one its galaxy page links (Mighty Chewy, Wako Tako, Lady Venomara, Mecha Leon); the Feather Cluster page links no boss. "Crash Site" links the four mothership parts and the final boss page "Nebulax". "Lost Galaxy" links about 20 level pages and is not on the Hub page, so it is placed after the main galaxies. Names only were looked at; nothing was copied. Chapter summaries are placeholders and need checking against play.
